name: walnut
description: Walnut Edge CMS — Edge-native headless & slot-assembly CMS built on Cloudflare Workers, D1, and R2.

scripts.dev: npm run build:css && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && node scripts/sync-theme-assets.mjs --local && wrangler dev --var ENVIRONMENT:development --var ALLOW_INSECURE_DEV_CF_ACCESS:true --var DEV_CF_ACCESS_EMAIL:admin@localhost
scripts.deploy: npm run build:css && node scripts/sync-theme-assets.mjs --remote && wrangler deploy --minify
